sentences.en: Juha loaded salt on the donkey.
The donkey fell into the water and the salt disappeared.
The load became light and the donkey was pleased.

sentences.ar: בפעם הבאה החמור נפל למים בכוונה.
sentences.en: The next time the donkey fell in the water on purpose.
But this time he was carrying wool.

sentences.ar: הצמר שתה את המים והיה כבד מאוד.
sentences.en: The wool drank the water and became very heavy.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: לכל דבר יש זמן.
sentences.en: Juha said: everything has its time.
